id./param/scenario/cs/b_160_cs_004.pack|cs_:
"Mordegon's stronghold...
  We've finally made it this far.
  Steel yourselves and move out.

"Hmph! You dodged my blade.
  No wonder you felled the Sentinels.

"I am Indignus, Dragon Sentinel!
  Guardian of Lord Mordegon's seat,
  this Sky Citadel!

"Luminary! Frail human though you are,
  I commend you for slipping past our forces
  and reaching this place!

"But our lord need not trouble himself
  with the likes of you!
  I shall spill your blood here!
